findings.claim: The R2 wording fix breaks the comma-cover-2016 row of the fixtures README table: the unescaped pipe inside the code span `grep -o | wc -l` is a GFM cell delimiter, so the row now has 7 cells in a 6-column table and renders garbled — the same defect class R1 was raised for, introduced by this repair commit.
findings.evidence: evals/fixtures/README.md:28 contains '`grep -o | wc -l` 40, `grep -c` 34'; awk cell count for line 28 is 6 at 7c116bb and 7 at HEAD (every other row in the table is 6); GFM treats pipes inside code spans as cell delimiters unless written as \|. The same phrase in evals/adversarial/comma-cover-period.json is JSON and unaffected.
findings.repro: git show 7c116bb:evals/fixtures/README.md | awk 'NR==28{print gsub(/\|/,"|")-1}'  # 6 ; awk 'NR==28{print gsub(/\|/,"|")-1}' evals/fixtures/README.md  # 7
findings.acceptance: README.md:28 counts 6 cells like its neighbours (write `grep -o \| wc -l`, or 'grep -o … piped to wc -l' outside a code span); the 40/34 numbers stay.
